source: Intermediate short story written in spoken Palestinian by Claude. NOT native-validated.

sentences.ar: بآخر الحارة، كان في دكان قديم لأبو سمير.
sentences.en: At the end of the neighborhood, there was an old shop belonging to Abu Samir.

sentences.ar: الدكان كان صغير بس فيه كل شي.
sentences.en: The shop was small but had everything.

sentences.ar: أبو سمير كان يعرف كل زبون باسمه.
sentences.en: Abu Samir knew every customer by name.

sentences.ar: لما كنا صغار، كنا نشتري منه حلوى.
sentences.en: When we were little, we used to buy sweets from him.

sentences.ar: كان دايما يعطينا قطعة زيادة ويضحك.
sentences.en: He always used to give us an extra piece and smile.

sentences.ar: مرة، ما كان معي مصاري وحبيت شوكولاتة.
sentences.en: Once, I had no money and wanted chocolate.

sentences.ar: أبو سمير عطاني ياها وقال ادفع بكرا.
sentences.en: Abu Samir gave it to me and said pay tomorrow.

sentences.ar: بعد سنين، الدكان سكر بس بنتذكره.
sentences.en: After years, the shop closed but we remember it.

sentences.ar: أبو سمير كان أكتر من بياع، كان صاحب.
sentences.en: Abu Samir was more than a seller, he was a friend.
